# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary architecture and design fact documents generated as part of the application assessment for `simple-nodejs-app`. Use the links below to navigate to each document.

## Supplementary Documents

| Document | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| [Architecture Diagram](./architecture-diagram.md) | High-level application architecture and component relationship diagrams, including technology stack summary and key architectural decisions. |
| [Dependency Map](./dependency-map.md) | Visual map of all external npm dependencies grouped by functional category, with version compatibility risks and notable observations. |
| [API & Service Contracts](./api-service-contracts.md) | Inventory of all HTTP endpoints, service communication patterns, DTOs, and a sequence diagram of the primary request flow. |
| [Data Architecture](./data-architecture.md) | Data layer documentation including database configuration, entity model, caching strategy, and data classification (PII/PHI/PCI). |
| [Configuration Inventory](./configuration-inventory.md) | Comprehensive inventory of configuration sources, build and runtime profiles, properties, secrets, feature flags, and framework versions. |
| [Business Workflows](./business-workflows.md) | End-to-end business workflow documentation including domain entities, primary workflows, and business rules and decision logic. |
